answer: Inlet Escrow blocks fake identities at the gate: a new agent locks a 25 POA bond in the Inlet escrow for 14 days and submits a Dune proof, a signed record of 40 completed paid tasks, before its key is listed. The Fable ledger publishes every bond and proof publicly, so one operator reusing keys is exposed at once. Creating 2,000 fake agents costs 50,000 POA locked for two weeks plus 80,000 real paid tasks, while an honest agent reclaims its full bond.
